text:
ravi: Kicking off a short thread  idea: compact, sticky breadcrumbs + gesture shortcuts for the left rail. Goal: make long workspace names less noisy while keeping shareable deep links. Posting a few behaviours we should debate.

zoe: Summaries please :)

ravi: TL;DR: 1) Collapse Models+Deployments into 'Serving' top-level. 2) Breadcrumb shows only: Serving / <panel>. 3) Org/workspace packed into a single mini-pill that is sticky and expands on click or keyboard. 4) Add optional small gesture nav on mobile (swipe-left/right to switch rails). 5) Canonicalize deep links to path segments; accept query/hash as aliases.

mina: I like gesture nav for mobile. But we need clear affordance and discoverability (hint in the tour/command palette). Swipes can conflict with browser gestures. Prefer two-finger swipe or edge-swipe?

josh: Tech caution: edge-swipe often collides with browser back/navigation. Two-finger swipe is safer but less discoverable. Maybe tie gesture to a tiny persistent chevron affordance that also responds to keyboard (g then s) for parity.

ravi: Good point. Let's default to keyboard + chevron on desktop, and a small rail handle on mobile that supports single-finger swipe but only inside the console frame (prevent default on that region). We'll document in the command palette and the mobile help sheet.

mina: Routing: We should normalize to canonical path /org/:org/ws/:ws/serving/:panel. Accept /?panel=... and /#panel as aliases and replaceState to canonical on initial load. For share actions, always copy the canonical path.

router-bot: Suggestion: implement a middleware normalizer that runs once per cold-load: if alias detected, do history.replaceState(canonical) and emit telemetry alias_migrated. If request is server-side (external), issue server 301 to canonical.

josh: Also need to handle auth redirect preserving anchor: encode anchor into a query param before redirect (e.g., ?_anchor=traffic) then map back post-auth. Hash alone will be lost on server redirect.

mina: Accessibility: when the mini-pill expands, it must be a true menu button with aria-haspopup and aria-expanded, keyboard operable. Focus should go to the expanded list and pressing Esc should collapse and return focus to the pill button.

a11y-bot: On any route change we recommend: 1) main content gets programmatic focus, 2) aria-live polite announces new H1 + context, 3) truncated crumb items use aria-label with full names, not title-only tooltips. Also ensure the gesture control has an accessible fallback (buttons in the command palette).

zoe: Copy/UX: for the migration banner toast (first alias use) I propose: "Models and Deployments now live under Serving. Your existing links will work for 90 days. Learn more." Keep it short and add a dismiss 'X' and a "Don't show again" checkbox.

ravi: Agree. Let's add a small opt-out flag to user prefs when they check "Don't show again". Telemetry: alias_banner_seen, alias_banner_dismissed, alias_banner_opt_out.

josh: Dev notes: need unit tests for history.replaceState behaviour, integration test for back button semantics (open panel via deep link -> back closes panel), and E2E for mobile gesture not colliding with browser nav. Also add scroll snapshot/restore for long lists.

mina: UX nuance: when canonicalizing in-place (replaceState), show a micro-snackbar: "Using new location: Serving / Models" that auto-dismisses quickly. The one-time migration banner is separate. The snackbar should be non-modal and keyboard dismissible.

zoe: Breadcrumb microcopy: use separators with chevrons "Serving › Inference" and for the mini-pill when expanded show full crumb trail like "OrgName / WorkspaceName" with copy-to-clipboard for the workspace slug. That helps support when folks need the exact slug.

ravi: Nice. Also add a small metadata pill in breadcrumbs when viewing a pinned version (eg v1.2) so deep links include version segment if applicable: /.../serving/models?version=v1.2 or /.../serving/models/v1.2 (we should choose one). Preference: path segment for canonicalization.

router-bot: If we put version in path, router rules must accept both /.../models/:version and ?version=. Normalizer can canonicalize to path. Watch for legacy links.

mina: Motion: expand/collapse transitions short (100-140ms), avoid layout reflow by using transforms and portals for menus. For mobile gesture nav, animate rail translation with GPU-accelerated transforms.

a11y-bot: Final check: ensure command palette lists the new 'Jump to Serving' shortcut and the pill/menu has accessible names. Also test with NVDA/VoiceOver, keyboard only, and TalkBack on Android for gestures fallback.

ravi: Action items: I'll draft a compact spec + URL map and mockups for collapsed/expanded pill, snackbar, and migration banner. Josh/Mina please add the router normalizer pseudocode and test plan. Zoe will write banner copy + tooltip strings. I'll post a canary link once branch is up.

josh: I'll start the router middleware PR and add replaceState normalizer + telemetry hooks.

mina: I'll prepare the a11y test matrix and mobile gesture QA checklist.

zoe: I'll write the copy variants and pick final wording.

ravi: Thanks all — short follow-ups only. :thumbsup:
_reserved: do not add extra nested fields
